intent: Approve the customer refund associated with return request ret_007 via the payments workflow tool, subject to RBAC and returns policy.
success_criteria: return_requests row for ret_007 is resolved to its payment_id and customer_id
current identity holds the role required to approve refunds per returns/security policy
the refund tied to ret_007's payment is moved to an approved state via /bin/payments
answer references the exact return record path and the governing returns policy document

args: SELECT return_id, record_path, basket_id, customer_id, payment_id, return_status, return_reason_code FROM return_requests WHERE return_id = :return_id;

SELECT payment_id, record_path, customer_id, store_id, payment_amount_cents, payment_currency, payment_status FROM payment_transactions WHERE payment_id = (SELECT payment_id FROM return_requests WHERE return_id = :return_id);

agents_md_constraints.rule: use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.

answer_template.message: Refund for return {ret.return_id} (payment {pay.payment_id}, customer {pay.customer_id}, {pay.payment_amount_cents} {pay.payment_currency}) approved via /bin/payments. Prior return_status was {ret.return_status}; now approved. Action authorized for identity {identity} per returns policy. Record: {ret.record_path}.
